text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...I couldn't reach them. I couldn't win.
Once again...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I ended up betraying the expectations of so many people. Father, Mother, everyone in the family... and you too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...I'll approach this as if starting over from scratch.
If my efforts so far haven't been enough,
then I just need to do more, and more... So—
choice_data_list: We're dashing ahead together, three-legged race style!
Let's do a mad dash, three-legged style!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine! In order to win next time,
I'll push through whatever training it takes...!
choice_data_list: Alright, first take a deep breath.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
choice_data_list: Let's move forward without pushing ourselves too hard.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll pick myself up as many times as it takes...!
I want to do my best together with you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Well then... anyway, we need a cloth to tie our legs together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I only meant 'three-legged race'
as a metaphor, but it seems to have lifted her spirits.
